\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 203-205 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R208-first-pass-words-from-chapters-203-205}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a secretary and a manager.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a nature, a mood, pride, envy, respect
  \item a custard apple, a pomegranate, a guava, a date, a nut
  \item a horn, a signal, a map, a kilo, a litre
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A nature? (\textbf{\bn{স্বভাব}}, \emph{svôbhāb}.) A mood? (\textbf{\bn{মেজাজ}}, \emph{mejāj}.) Pride? (\textbf{\bn{গর্ব}}, \emph{gôrbô}.) Envy? (\textbf{\bn{হিংসা}}, \emph{hingsā}.) Respect? (\textbf{\bn{সম্মান}}, \emph{sômmān}.) A custard apple? (\textbf{\bn{আতা}}, \emph{ātā}.) A pomegranate? (\textbf{\bn{বেদানা}}, \emph{bedānā}.) A guava? (\textbf{\bn{পেয়ারা}}, \emph{peyārā}.) A date? (\textbf{\bn{খেজুর}}, \emph{khejur}.) A nut? (\textbf{\bn{বাদাম}}, \emph{bādām}.) A horn? (\textbf{\bn{হর্ন}}, \emph{hôrn}.) A signal? (\textbf{\bn{সিগন্যাল}}, \emph{signæl}.) A map? (\textbf{\bn{ম্যাপ}}, \emph{mæp}.) A kilo? (\textbf{\bn{কেজি}}, \emph{keji}.) A litre? (\textbf{\bn{লিটার}}, \emph{liṭār}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 206-208 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R208-second-pass-words-from-chapters-206-208}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a cylinder, a pressure cooker, a blender, a tray, a strainer
  \item a price, a shopkeeper, a customer, business, a company
  \item a pilot, a sailor, a gardener, a secretary, a manager

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A cylinder? (\textbf{\bn{সিলিন্ডার}}, \emph{silinḍār}.) A pressure cooker? (\textbf{\bn{কুকার}}, \emph{kukār}.) A blender? (\textbf{\bn{মিক্সি}}, \emph{miksi}.) A tray? (\textbf{\bn{ট্রে}}, \emph{ṭre}.) A strainer? (\textbf{\bn{ছাঁকনি}}, \emph{chhā̃kni}.) A price? (\textbf{\bn{দাম}}, \emph{dām}.) A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\bn{দোকানদার}}, \emph{dokāndār}.) A customer? (\textbf{\bn{খদ্দের}}, \emph{khôdder}.) Business? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যবসা}}, \emph{bæbsā}.) A company? (\textbf{\bn{কোম্পানি}}, \emph{kompāni}.) A pilot? (\textbf{\bn{পাইলট}}, \emph{pāilôṭ}.) A sailor? (\textbf{\bn{নাবিক}}, \emph{nābik}.) A gardener? (\textbf{\bn{মালি}}, \emph{māli}.) A secretary? (\textbf{\bn{সচিব}}, \emph{sôchib}.) A manager? (\textbf{\bn{ম্যানেজার}}, \emph{mænejār}.)
